labels.note: Chained & on retry_all returns None instead of flattened retry_all; breaks combinator chaining.
Chained | on retry_any returns None instead of flattened retry_any; breaks combinator chaining.
retry_always sentinel now never retries; inverts documented always-retry behavior.
Inverts retry_if_not_exception_type predicate; would retry/not-retry on wrong exception types.
Default 'no matching cause' fallback flips to True, causing spurious retries even on success.
Failure-path fallback flips to True, causing retry_if_not_result to retry on exceptions unexpectedly.
Success case now returns falsy None instead of True, stopping retries prematurely.
__ror__ flatten path returns None instead of combined retry_any; breaks reversed | chaining.
